Answer: I do some exercise every day to stay healthy and active.
Tarjima: Bundan tashqari, bu menga kun bo‘yi energiya beradi.
Reason: Because it helps me stay fit and improves my health.
Example: For example, I usually go jogging or do stretching exercises in the morning.
Extra Info: Also, it gives me energy for the whole day.

Answer: I do housework at home to help my family.
Reason: Because I want to keep my home clean and organized.
Example: For example, I clean my room, wash dishes, and sweep the floor.

Answer: I do the shopping on weekends when I am free.
Tarjima: Bu oilamga vaqtni tejashga yordam beradi.
Reason: Because it is more comfortable when I have free time.
Example: For example, I buy food, drinks, and household items.
Extra Info: It helps my family save time.

Answer: I do some work in the evening after my classes.
Reason: Because I am busy during the daytime.
Example: For example, I complete my tasks and check my emails.
Extra Info: It helps me improve my skills.

Answer: I do my homework after school every day.
Tarjima: Bu menga yaxshi o‘qishga va yuqori baho olishga yordam beradi.
Reason: Because my teachers give me homework regularly.
Example: For example, I write exercises and learn new grammar rules.
Extra Info: It helps me learn better and get good grades.

Answer: I make future plans for my education and life.
Reason: Because I want to have a successful future.
Example: For example, I plan to study at university and learn English well.
Extra Info: It motivates me to work harder.

Answer: I make a to-do list every morning before starting my day.
Tarjima: Bu muhim narsalarni unutmaslikka yordam beradi.
Reason: Because it helps me stay organized.
Example: For example, I write my homework, chores, and other tasks.
Extra Info: It helps me not forget important things.

Answer: I stay in for the evening when I feel tired.
Tarjima: Bu menga uzoq kundan keyin dam olishga yordam beradi.
Reason: Because I want to relax and rest at home.
Example: For example, I watch TV or listen to music.
Extra Info: It helps me relax after a long day.

Answer: I eat healthy food every day to stay strong.
Reason: Because it is good for my body and health.
Example: For example, I eat fruits, vegetables, and drink water.

Answer: I have an early night when I am very tired.
Tarjima: Bu menga ertalab tetik uyg‘onishga yordam beradi.
Reason: Because I need enough sleep for my body.
Example: For example, I go to bed at 9 or 10 pm.
Extra Info: It helps me wake up fresh in the morning.

Answer: I sometimes go to bed late when I have a lot of work.
Tarjima: Bu keyingi kuni charchoq his qilishga olib keladi.
Reason: Because I need to finish my tasks first.
Example: For example, I study or finish homework at night.
Extra Info: It makes me feel tired the next day.

Answer: I have fun when I spend time with my friends.
Tarjima: Bu stressni kamaytiradi va kayfiyatni yaxshilaydi.
Reason: Because it makes me happy and relaxed.
Example: For example, we play games or go out together.
Extra Info: It reduces stress and improves mood.

Answer: I have a good time when I go to parties or trips.
Reason: Because I enjoy spending time with people.
Example: For example, we dance, talk, and take photos.

Answer: I have a family meal every Sunday with my family.
Reason: Because family time is very important for me.
Example: For example, we eat together and talk about our week.

Answer: I have a lie-in on weekends because I don’t go to school.
Reason: Because I want to rest after a busy week.
Example: For example, I wake up around 10 or 11 am.
Extra Info: It helps me feel more relaxed.

Answer: I go on a trip in summer with my family.
Tarjima: Bu menga yangi tajriba va xotiralar beradi.
Reason: Because I love exploring new places.
Example: For example, we visit mountains or different cities.
Extra Info: It gives me new experiences and memories.

Answer: I go shopping with my friends on weekends.
Reason: Because it is fun and enjoyable.
Example: For example, we buy clothes and shoes.
Extra Info: We also spend good time together.

Answer: I chat with my friends online every day.
Reason: Because we live far from each other.
Example: For example, we use social media and messaging apps.
Extra Info: It helps us stay in touch.
